FCRA Bill Debate Set for August 12 After Minister Meets Christian Leaders and CM

The Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act (FCRA) Amendment Bill is scheduled for parliamentary debate on August 12. This follows a meeting between Union Home Minister Amit Shah and a delegation of Christian leaders, who expressed concerns about the bill. Shah reportedly assured them the government has no intention to harass the Christian community and that the bill would not have retrospective effect. Mizoram Chief Minister Lalduhoma also met Shah and conveyed that the bill would not be retrospective, and indicated the August 12 debate date. A clause regarding 'deemed cessation of assets' was flagged by the Christian forum.
